cases.name: distinct-that-is-neither-true-nor-false
cases.description: The attribute takes two words. Silently treating anything else as false would be a config that says one thing and gets another.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="2" distinct="yes"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distinct-without-repeat
cases.description: One value cannot repeat itself, so the attribute would be read and then do nothing — the accepted-and-ignored failure this project keeps closing.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" distinct="true"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: percent-and-distinct-on-one-gen
cases.description: percent= is an exact quota over the whole run; distinct= is a guarantee inside one row. Holding both would cost either streaming or the randomness of the sample, so the pair is refused rather than silently resolved one way.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="2" percent="70,20,10" distinct="true"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: percent-and-repeat-without-distinct-stay-legal
cases.description: The pair that is NOT refused. Article tags — one to four per row, 40/30/20/10 across the corpus — is a real, documented feature, and only the interaction with distinct is a contradiction.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="2" percent="70,20,10"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-list-longer-than-the-pool
cases.description: Ten different values cannot be drawn from three. Provable from the config, so it is refused before anything runs.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" repeat="1..10" distinct="true"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-one-character-symbol-set-is-counted-too
cases.description: The set is written out in the config, so the pool is five and the refusal fires at check time rather than after 64 run-time retries.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="symbol" value="ABCDE" repeat="9" distinct="true"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-longer-symbol-is-not-guessed-at
cases.description: length="3" draws a three-character string, so the pool is no longer the set size. Refusing here on a guess would reject a config that works, so this one falls to the run-time arm.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="symbol" value="ABCDE" length="3" repeat="9" distinct="true"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}}</data></line></block></tdc>
